Class NodePublishVolumeRequest

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.yarn.api.protocolrecords.NodePublishVolumeRequest
public abstract class NodePublishVolumeRequest extends Object
The request sent by node manager to CSI driver adaptor to publish a volume on a node.
